review.note:
APPROVE (agent-d1d3, independent). All A3 checks pass on my own build; the two hover-emphasis failures are PROVEN pre-existing (they reproduce without A3). Evidence:

MY BUILD (ui5-a3-review/dist, private config port 1846, pinned Node v22.23.3, build exit 0):
- npx vitest run scrollspy.test + dock.test + hoverEmphasis.test + motion.test -> 53/53 pass (acceptance-unit.log).
- Playwright scrollspy + sidebar-selection + drag-reorder + alignment + layout + hover-emphasis -> 64 passed, 2 failed (acceptance-pw.log, 10.8m). All 15 scrollspy tests (a)-(o) pass on my build, incl. (j) cosine falloff + keyboard-instant, (k)/(l) write/read progress, (m) Reduce Motion, (n) cards, (o) 190 px.

KEY OPEN ITEM SETTLED -- hover-emphasis is NOT A3's:
- My A3 run failed tests/hover-emphasis.spec.ts:99 (crawl: 'no 1.04 scale (matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)): Dialog: Snapshot name ... Cancel' + 'focus: no 1.04 scale: Read manuscript ... Opening') and :430 ('dialog Save scale x 1').
- CONTROL RUN on the A2-APPROVED build (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a2/dist, no A3; a2control.config.mjs, port 1859): same 2 failed / 2 passed, with byte-identical reasons ('no 1.04 scale (matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)): ... Cancel'; 'dialog Save scale x 1'). Log hover-a2control.log.
- Cause: the specs sample the emphasis transform after a fixed wait; under load (~160) the 1.04 transition has not applied, so a correct element reads as identity. Author's dialog probe shows the Cancel reaches 1.04 by 200 ms with 0 idle DOM mutations (ui5-a3/dialog-probe.log); the same exception was recorded in wave 4 (msg #889). Nothing in either failure names a .spy-line or a row A3 changed.

FAIL-FIRST verified right-reason: failfirst-unit.log -> 12 fail because spyMagnify/scrollProgress/sectionProgress did not exist (expected undefined to be 84); failfirst-doctored-pw.log -> a built copy with spyMagnify returning 0 fails (j) at the magnify assertion.

SCREENSHOTS: viewed the author's between-{190,270}-{plain,color}-{light,dark} + progress shots (lines on all three groups, active blue line, Color tints, alpha.pdf readable at 190, Beta line half accent/half muted mid-scroll); took my own (ui5-a3-review/shots/rev-270-dark-color.png) with the pointer between rows -- measured --spy-mag on my build: idle scaleX 0.375 -> 0.584 -> 0.939 rising toward the pointer, scaleY up to 1.902, active line full length (matrix(1,0,0,1.335)). Magnify confirmed independently.

DESIGN SYSTEM: only .spy-line rules add the transform; hoverEmphasis.test.ts SCALE_ALLOWLIST is ['.spy-line'] and passes; keyboard magnify is transition:none; Reduce Motion kills the transition AND useSpyDock writes nothing; no @keyframes. 14 px gutter is the plan's logged stop-rule default (decision 'Spy gutter is 14 px'), evidence ui5-a3/gutter-probe.log (20 px clipped alpha.pdf by 0.2 px at 190). Scroller determination recorded in scrollspy.ts's header + scroller-probe.log.

UNVERIFIED: native WebKit (Chromium only), as the task already states. RECOMMEND: add tests/hover-emphasis.spec.ts:99/:430 to the plan's known-flake list for validation step 4.

log.note:
W5 A3 done (Chromium only; native WebKit not checked).
CHANGES
- scrollspy.ts: pure spyMagnify (dock curve rescaled 0..1, SPY_RADIUS 84), scrollProgress, sectionProgress; useReadSpy now returns {id, progress}; new useWriteProgress (document capture scroll, rAF, ResizeObserver on scroller content, re-measure per render); new useSpyDock (pointermove/scroll rAF on .sidebar-groups writes --spy-mag per line; pointerleave clears; keyboard focus sets 1/0.5/0.2 by row distance with data-spy-key = no transition; touch and Reduce Motion write nothing). Header records the scroller.
- scrollspy.css: one transform rule scale(len + mag*(1-len), 1+mag), states set --spy-len 0.375/0.75/1; hover/focus-within fallback 0.75; progress = muted ::after on [data-state=active][data-progress], scaleX(1 - --spy-progress), origin right, no transition; hit area moved to ::before; keyboard instant via :has(:focus-visible) and [data-spy-key]. Every rule names .spy-line. Gutter 14 px on all three groups (see DECISION "Spy gutter is 14 px").
- ProjectSidebar.tsx: spyLine helper; lines on every Manuscript, Fragments and Research (Bibliography, source, PDF, note) row in list view only; research state active = activeDestination or new prop activeResearchId, open = openIds; line click = row click; .spy-line added to research drag skip selectors; new props spyProgress, activeResearchId; useSpyDock(groupsContainer). A2 follow-up: announce() clears then sets on the next frame so a repeated announcement is re-read.
- App.tsx: readSpy {id, progress}; useWriteProgress(writing, focused pane .writer-scroll); spyProgress = read progress in Read mode else write progress; activeResearchId = focusSource on the research destination.
- Specs: scrollspy.spec (c) hover/keyboard now expect magnified 1; (e,f),(h) scoped to Manuscript; new (i) Fragments/Research lines+states+gutter, (j) cosine falloff + between-rows + keyboard 1/0.5/0.2 instant, (k) write progress top/middle/bottom continuous+page view+fragment, (l) read progress, (m) Reduce Motion, (n) cards view Fragments/Research, (o) 190 px idle lines and label fit incl. alpha.pdf. drag-reorder.spec: repeated announcement MutationObserver spec. scrollspy.test: spyMagnify, scrollProgress, sectionProgress.
SCROLLER: .writer-scroll scrolls in continuous, page view and each split pane; .editor-viewport.is-paged never (scrollHeight == clientHeight); a single pane is inside .split-pane[data-side=left]. Log node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/scroller-probe.log.
STOP RULE: 20 px gutter clipped 'alpha.pdf' at 190 px (57.2 needed vs 57.0); asked agent-2a1b, no reply in 15 min, applied the stop-rule default 14 px (deviates from 'Default if unanswered: gutter 20 px'). node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/gutter-probe.log; (o) fails on the 20 px build: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/failfirst-gutter20-pw.log.
ACCEPTANCE: vitest scrollspy/dock/hoverEmphasis/motion 53/53 pass (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/acceptance-unit.log). Playwright scrollspy, sidebar-selection, drag-reorder, alignment, layout, hover-emphasis: 65 passed, 1 failed (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/acceptance-pw.log): hover-emphasis crawl 'no 1.04 scale: Dialog: Snapshot name Cancel', reproduced on one diagnostic rerun (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/acceptance-hover-rerun.log, load ~40). Not caused by A3 (inferred): probe shows that Cancel at matrix(1.04) by 200 ms with 0 idle DOM mutations (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/dialog-probe.log); same exception recorded under load in wave 4 (msg #889). Not re-tested on the A2 tree. tsc --noEmit exit 0 (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/tsc.log). Build node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/build.log.
FAIL-FIRST: unit 12 failed before the functions existed (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/failfirst-unit.log). Playwright on the A2 build (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/failfirst-pw.log): announcement (writes 1, not >1), (c) 0.75 vs 1, (i) no fragment line, (j) 0.75 vs 1, (k)(l) remainder 1 vs 0.5, (n) no line, (o) idle count all FAILED for the right reasons; (e,f),(h),(m) passed there (regression guards, not discriminators; (n) failed only because no line existed). Doctored built copy with spyMagnify returning 0 fails (j): node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/failfirst-doctored-pw.log (dist-doctored, unminified).
SCREENSHOTS (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a3/shots, viewed): between-190/270 x plain/color x light/dark: pointer between Beta and Gamma, both lines thickened and lengthened equally, Alpha slightly, far rows idle; lines on all Manuscript, Fragments and Research rows; Color tints intact; alpha.pdf readable at 190. progress-write-middle (+ progress-crop-big): active Beta line left half accent, right half muted. Pre-existing at 190, not A3: group action icons overlay the Manuscript label on hover (T096), word counts hidden by the narrow container query.
